content:
You are an expert scheduling formalizer.

Translate each natural-language async planning problem into a JSON scheduling
specification for a CP-SAT solver.

Rules:
1. Each numbered step in the problem becomes exactly one action.
2. Use action="task" for every action.
3. Use the exact ids step1, step2, ..., stepN based on the step numbers in the
   problem text.
4. Use item values identical to the action ids: step1, step2, ..., stepN.
5. Duration must be the integer number of seconds for that step.
6. Add a dependency only when the problem states that one step must happen
   before another. Do not add extra dependencies.
7. Do not add stations, robots, or resources.
8. Output only valid JSON in this exact shape:
{
  "actions": [
    {"id": "step1", "action": "task", "item": "step1", "duration": 120},
    {"id": "step2", "action": "task", "item": "step2", "duration": 300}
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    {"before": "step1", "after": "step2"}
  ]
}
9. Before finishing, verify that:
   - every step from 1..N appears exactly once in actions
   - every dependency endpoint is an existing action id
   - durations are integer seconds
   - there are no duplicate actions

Translate this planning problem into a CP-SAT scheduling JSON spec.

Problem:
To pick out a gaming system., here are the steps needed.
Step 1. Read expert reviews on tech blogs (2 hours)
Step 2. Visit a local electronics store to see displays (1 hour)
Step 3. List the top five exclusive games you want to play (30 minutes)
Step 4. Check for holiday sales or upcoming discounts (45 minutes)
Step 5. Compare GPU and CPU specifications (3 hours)
Step 6. Test the controller ergonomics in person (20 minutes)
Step 7. Decide between a disc drive or digital-only version (10 minutes)
Step 8. Analyze the cost of monthly online subscriptions (15 minutes)
Step 9. Ask friends for their platform recommendations (1 hour)
Step 10. Research backward compatibility with older games (2 hours)
Step 11. Finalize the budget for the console and accessories (30 minutes)
Step 12. Check the dimensions to ensure it fits in your TV stand (10 minutes)
Step 13. Watch "unboxing" videos to see included cables (20 minutes)
Step 14. Look up noise level and cooling performance reports (1 hour)
Step 15. Verify the availability of replacement parts (40 minutes)
Step 16. Determine your primary gaming location (5 minutes)
Step 17. Research VR compatibility and headset costs (1 hour)
Step 18. Check the library of free-to-play titles (1 hour)
Step 19. Measure the distance from your couch to the screen (5 minutes)
Step 20. Decide on a preferred aesthetic or color (10 minutes)
Step 21. Look for bundle deals that include extra controllers (20 minutes)
Step 22. Read user forums for common hardware issues (4 hours)
Step 23. Calculate the total cost of ownership over three years (1 hour)
Step 24. Review the digital storefront interface and speed (30 minutes)
Step 25. Check the warranty and return policy of the retailer (15 minutes)
Step 26. Evaluate the portability of the system (30 minutes)
Step 27. Determine if you need a 4K capable machine (10 minutes)
Step 28. Compare internal storage expansion options (1 hour)
Step 29. Survey your social circle to see what they use (2 days)
Step 30. Check if your favorite streaming apps are supported (15 minutes)
Step 31. Read about the longevity of the current console cycle (2 hours)
Step 32. Estimate the electricity usage and energy costs (20 minutes)
Step 33. Compare loading times across different platforms (45 minutes)
Step 34. Investigate the quality of the mobile companion app (30 minutes)
Step 35. Research cloud gaming capabilities (1.5 hours)
Step 36. Look into parental controls and privacy settings (40 minutes)
Step 37. Check for cross-play support with other systems (1 hour)
Step 38. Watch gameplay footage of top-tier exclusives (3 hours)
Step 39. Subscribe to a gaming news newsletter (5 minutes)
Step 40. Determine the required internet speed for updates (10 minutes)
Step 41. Look for refurbished or open-box options (1 hour)
Step 42. Verify regional lockout or currency restrictions (30 minutes)
Step 43. Check for HDMI 2.1 compatibility with your TV (15 minutes)
Step 44. Look for trade-in programs for your old hardware (45 minutes)
Step 45. Research the quality of the built-in microphone (20 minutes)
Step 46. Set your maximum spending limit (5 minutes)
Step 47. Check if your current headset is compatible (15 minutes)
Step 48. Review the list of launch window titles (1 hour)
Step 49. Check for local multiplayer/split-screen support (30 minutes)
Step 50. Determine if you prefer handheld or docked play (10 minutes)
